title: SyntheticData
summary: A small Python toolkit for uploading local CSV datasets, building SDV metadata, and generating diagnostic and quality reports comparing real versus synthetic tabular data, with a companion visualize.py using sdmetrics' plotting utilities. SDV's load_csvs, Metadata, run_diagnostic, and evaluate_quality functions are called directly, alongside sdmetrics' reporting and plotting utilities imported separately.
